provenance.source_snapshot: CFFI v2.1.1; README traces ancestor to CPython e04e1f253ed8 / GCC CVS 2004-01-27, with CFFI modifications
provenance.vulnerability_review: Required separately for this fork; a scan of current upstream libffi does not cover it
